blocking_findings.impact: The findings cannot define reusable shared-kit contracts because their statements and boundaries do not correspond to one causal behavior that all included claims exercise.
blocking_findings.required_remediation: Discard automatic claim batches. Curate each finding around one invariant or one comparison axis, then select only direct claims that would make the statement unsupported if removed.

blocking_findings.title: At least 48 of 563 capability uses are high-confidence context-only records
blocking_findings.selection_rule: This exact set is restricted to clear type-vocabulary, file or negative-search, route or fixture, test-id, rendering, UI-scaffolding, asset-loading, navigation, or unrelated presentation records. It deliberately excludes less-certain cross-capability candidates, so 48 is a lower bound.
blocking_findings.impact: Generated excerpt-paraphrase relevance sentences promote context by assertion and allow irrelevant records to satisfy capability and cross-game denominators.
blocking_findings.required_remediation: Route the exact set to non-capability context unless a separate complete excerpt demonstrates a directly supported capability. Apply the v8 counterfactual pertinence question to every remaining curated use.

blocking_findings.title: All 87 boundary effects are generated validation, sequencing, choices, and hidden-policy templates
blocking_findings.impact: The effects are syntactically unique but do not state a hand-authored shared invariant, game-owned variant, or implementable interface consequence.
blocking_findings.required_remediation: Write one concrete ownership decision per curated finding after its evidence is fixed. Reject effects that can be recreated by substituting the capability, dimension, game names, or excerpt keywords.

blocking_findings.title: All 87 statements are generated keyword summaries rather than complete evidence synthesis
observed_failure_modes: keyword fragments omit verbs, objects, qualifiers, or consequences
the first available excerpt fragments are treated as the finding dimension
per-game summaries concatenate inventories with pipe separators
different mechanics are made comparable merely because they share capability vocabulary
statements remain grammatical only at the outer template level
blocking_findings.impact: A developer cannot derive a stable shared contract or game extension from the text without reopening the complete Phase 1 evidence.
blocking_findings.required_remediation: Hand-author one complete statement after selecting a bounded direct-evidence set. Each per-game behavior must be one sentence and each difference must name the same behavioral axis for every game.

accounting.rule: Account for every record exactly once as curated capability evidence or non-capability context, but do not force every record into a reusable capability.

capability_selection.counterfactual_pertinence_question: If this claim were removed, would the exact invariant or game-specific variant become unsupported?
default_context_forms: render-only facts outside presentation or feedback findings

assembly_order: Classify every accepted Phase 1 mechanic record as directly reusable evidence or context.
For each potential use, answer the counterfactual pertinence question and select one complete excerpt.
Group selected uses only when they express one identical invariant or one identical comparison axis.
Write one-sentence per-game behavior summaries without pipe-concatenated inventories.
Hand-author the finding statement and three architectural consequences from the curated evidence.
Verify all game dispositions, claim limits, context routes, and dependency bindings before truth Green.
truth_requirements: Reject the bound mapper v4 bundle as an over-batched counterexample.
Reject findings and use sets above the v8 budgets.
Reject more than the allowed direct claims per game or finding.

candidate_assessment: The rejected mapper v4 bundle is not suitable as a shared-kit capability contract and must not be repaired by text substitution alone. Evidence must be reclassified and curated before mapper v5 findings are assembled.
publication_boundary: This is a pre-remediation audit only. It is not the final v8 independent review or reviewer receipt and does not review mapper v5, v8 Green, root acceptance, Phase 3, assets, responsive behavior, implementation, or shipping.
